title: Rear Quarter Panel Speaker Removal and Installation
introduction:
The speaker is the easy part; reaching it is a nesting-doll exercise in seats and trim. I work through those layers in order so the hidden clips, seatbelts and convertible flap get the same attention as the speaker itself.

This guide covers the convertible rear quarter panel speaker on vehicles with SYNC 2/SYNC 3 and the listed 2.3L, 3.7L and 5.0L engines. The preparation below explains the linked seat and trim access, and the installation instructions carry those parts back into place. This procedure covers removal and refitting; it includes no electrical diagnosis or acoustic acceptance test.

items.name: Prevent unintended starting
items.detail: If equipped, disable remote start through the Central Display under Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before beginning service. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started during the work, causing personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle during service to prevent another person from starting the engine; an accidental start can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Protect eyes, ears and hands
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling pointed or sharp-edged components. Failure to follow these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Prepare for controlled tightening
items.detail: Have torque tools suitable for tightening the speaker mounting bolts and the rear seat backrest fasteners to their respective specifications.

items.name: Open the convertible top
items.detail: Fully open the convertible top before removing the rear seat backrest and loadspace trim.

items.name: Remove the rear seat cushion
items.detail: Use [Rear Seat Cushion](#/document/G1692168). Move both front seats fully forward. At the front of the rear cushion, press the locking tabs inward to release the cushion from the floor, then lift, release and remove it. NOTICE: Press the tabs in before lifting; pulling without releasing them can damage the tabs.

items.name: Remove the rear seat backrest
items.detail: Use [Rear Seat Backrest - Convertible](#/document/G1709034). With the cushion removed, release the fasteners attaching the backrest to the floor. Release the backrest locking clips and remove the backrest, lifting it as illustrated. During refitting, tighten the backrest-to-floor fasteners to 35 lb.ft (47.5 Nm).

items.name: Preserve the seat structure
items.detail: WARNING: The seat procedure contains critical installation steps. Follow every note and step carefully. Do not put objects between the seat components and the vehicle body or inside any joint in the seat structure. Incorrect assembly may prevent the seat components from operating correctly and increases the risk of serious personal injury.

items.name: Read the correct illustration
items.detail: The loadspace trim illustrations show LHD and the RH side; RHD and the LH side are similar. Blue identifies the target panel, magenta identifies attachments or connections to release, and yellow identifies parts to position aside.

items.name: Remove the upper panel
items.detail: After removing the rear backrest, position the seatbelt guide aside, release the upper loadspace trim panel clips and lift the panel away as illustrated. Its installation has a separate convertible-flap check described in the refitting step.

items.name: Remove the middle panel
items.detail: Release the middle loadspace trim panel clips. Pull the panel forward and outward to release its rear tab, position the front and rear safety belts aside, and remove the panel. The rear tab needs this directional release before the panel can come away.

items.name: Remove the remaining access panels
items.detail: Release the scuff plate trim panel clips and remove that panel. Then release the lower loadspace trim panel clips and remove the lower panel. The lower-panel illustration shows its front end lifting and its rear end moving downward.

items.name: Keep the convertible flap clear
items.detail: Before installing the upper loadspace trim panel, visually inspect the convertible flap and position it aside if required. Make sure it does not become trapped underneath the panel. Install the panel, then return the seatbelt guide to position.

items.name: Restore usable seatbelts
items.detail: During trim, backrest and cushion installation, make sure the seatbelt webbing is not twisted and that the seatbelts and buckles remain accessible to occupants.

edits.text: NOTE: Read the removal steps before starting; they also contain details needed during installation.
edits.why: The tightening specification appears with removal, so it needs to stay in view when the speaker goes back.

edits.text: Remove the convertible loadspace trim panel using [Loadspace Trim Panel - Convertible](#/document/G1692610) (501-05 Interior Trim and Ornamentation, Removal and Installation).
edits.why: This access involves the rear cushion and backrest, followed by the upper and middle loadspace panels, scuff plate and lower panel. Work through the preparation above in that order. I treat the trim like a puzzle with release points: the middle panel's rear tab needs a forward-and-outward movement, rather than more pulling force.

edits.text: Remove the speaker mounting bolts and the rear quarter panel speaker, disconnecting its electrical connector as described below.
edits.why: I use the drawing to locate the magenta mounting bolts around the blue speaker and the electrical connector at its lower edge. These are the attachments that must be released for the speaker to come away.

edits.text: Disconnect the speaker's electrical connector. During installation, tighten the speaker mounting bolts to 22 lb.in (2.5 Nm).
edits.why: The tightening specification applies to the speaker mounting bolts. The electrical connector is disconnected for removal and reconnected during installation.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence. Reconnect the speaker's electrical connector, refit the speaker and tighten its mounting bolts to the specification above. Reinstall the lower loadspace trim panel, scuff plate trim panel and middle loadspace trim panel, returning the belts to position as the middle panel is fitted. Before fitting the upper loadspace trim panel, visually inspect the convertible flap and position it aside if required. Install the upper panel without trapping the flap underneath it, then return the seatbelt guide to position. Reinstall the rear backrest and cushion by reversing their removal procedures, securing the backrest locking clips, tightening its floor fasteners to the specification in the preparation above and engaging the cushion locking tabs. Throughout reassembly, make sure the seatbelt webbing is not twisted and the belts and buckles are accessible to occupants.
edits.why: The upper panel has a specific installation exception: the convertible flap must remain clear underneath it. I finish by checking the seat attachments and belt routing, because a tidy-looking cabin alone cannot confirm that the seats are secured and the restraints are usable.
